topic: Yuta's Copy was never the real danger to Gojo: Prison Realm and Sukuna's slash were, and Yuta was the backup plan
title: Yuta's Copy Was Never The Real Threat To Gojo
description:
Yuta Okkotsu's Copy is the power fans feared would one day overtake Gojo, but the two things that actually beat Gojo had nothing to do with it. This breakdown follows the Prison Realm loophole in Shibuya, Sukuna's world-cutting technique in Shinjuku, and why Yuta was always Gojo's insurance, not his rival.

We use the manga chapters from Jujutsu Kaisen 0 through the Shinjuku Showdown. Which threat do you think was the real one, and could Yuta have changed either?
comment: Was the Prison Realm or Sukuna's slash the bigger failure for Gojo? Pick one and defend it.
